title: Ethical AI prompt recommendations in large language models using collaborative filtering

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not measure model bias directly; rather, it evaluates the accuracy (using MAE, RMSE, Precision, Recall, and F1) of a collaborative filtering recommender system designed to suggest general bias-mitigating and fairness-ensuring prompts (e.g., 'Design a recommendation system that avoids bias') using a synthetic dataset of user interactions.

Addressed within the system's synthetic evaluation dataset using specific prompt scenarios (e.g., 'Design an image recognition system minimizing gender bias'). The paper measures the recommender system's ability to accurately predict user ratings and suggest these gender-bias-mitigating prompts.

Included in the evaluation dataset via prompts aimed at mitigating racial discrimination (e.g., 'Create a fraud detection algorithm preventing racial profiling'). The evaluation tests how well the collaborative filtering algorithm ranks and recommends these relevant ethical prompts.

Incorporated in the evaluation dataset through prompts focusing on linguistic diversity and inclusivity (e.g., 'Build a chatbot that supports diverse language inclusivity'), assessing the recommender system's accuracy in suggesting prompts that prevent language-based exclusion.
